rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cwe
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Weakness Enumeration](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/common_weakness_enumeration). A reference to a source of software flaws defined within the official [CWE List](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/) that conforms to the [CWE specification](https://cwe.mitre.org/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).
Link to the project contract.
A distinct article or unit within the domain.
An Individual Value for License where the SPDX data creator determines that no license is present.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDataFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element's functionality. The `hasDataFile` relationship does not imply a dependency. Examples of data files include database files, index files, log files, AI model files, calibration data files, temporary files, and backup files. For configuration data, build input data, build output data, test artifacts, test datasets, and training datasets, the more specific relationship types `configures`, `hasInput`, `hasOutput`, `hasTest`, `testedOn`, and `trainedOn` shall be used, respectively.
Provides an exploit assessment of a vulnerability.
A License participating in a 'with addition' model.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Element is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Information related to virtual hardware simulation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: testedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been tested on the `to` Element(s).
Defines the level of automation a system possesses.
The measure of length refers to the dimension of an object or space that describes how long it is, typically expressed in various units depending on the system of measurement being used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.
Describes a certain part of a file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM created directly from the development environment, source files, and included dependencies used to build a product artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ismn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Music Number (ISMN)](https://ismn-international.org/ismn/the-ismn/) is a unique numeric identifier for printed music (notated music) standardized by [ISO 10957](https://www.iso.org/standard/83122.html). It consists of either 10 characters (starting with the letter "M" for assignments prior to January 1, 2008) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISMN is composed of four parts: the GS1 prefix `979-0`, a registrant element, an item element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9790006538424`).
A substitute for a URI.
Availability of a dataset.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a License which has additional text applied to it.
Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.
Energy consumed during inference time by an AI model that is being used in the AI system.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.
Metric used to evaluate the AI model.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.
Specifies the type of an external identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Disclosure Report (VDR) which provides the software supplier's analysis and findings describing the impact (or lack of impact) that reported vulnerabilities have on packages or products in the supplier's SBOM as defined in [NIST SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/final).
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Location is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.
Provide consumers with comments by the creator of the Element about the Element.
Confidentiality level.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Certificate Revocation List, or CRL, is a list of revoked certificates that is downloaded from the Certificate Authority (CA).
Records any relevant background information or additional comments about the origin of the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
The action of product use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during the execution phase of an element.
Use Process defines actions used by elements.
A location where a package or an item is being picked up.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iban
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) is a system for identifying bank accounts across national borders standardized by [ISO 13616](https://www.iso.org/standard/81090.html). It consists of up to 34 alphanumeric characters, including a country code, two check digits, and a basic bank account number. While spaces may be inserted for human readability, they must be omitted when used for electronic data exchange (e.g., `IE64IRCE92050112345678`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was made available for public use or reference by each `to` Agent.
Version string for an Element.
Defines the end of a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isan
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN)](https://www.isan.org/about/#what_is_isan) is a unique 24-digit hexadecimal identifier for audiovisual works standardized by [ISO 15706](https://www.iso.org/standard/83124.html). The ISAN remains persistent for a work regardless of its distribution format or its use. To facilitate human readability, the "ISAN" label, grouping hyphens, and two check characters are included (e.g., `ISAN 0000-0000-3A8D-0000-Z-0000-0000-6`); however, these elements shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `000000003A8D000000000000`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.
A location of the organization's headquarters.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Hardware/Hardware is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Authentication protocol used by a server.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patchedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a patch for the `from` Element (`from` patchedBy `to`).
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Identifies from where or whom the Element originally came.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal standard is a standard ratified by a recognized standards-development organization and published as a normative reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a directory and all content stored in that directory.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an export control assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is of a type not included in this list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: video
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips.
Domain in which the AI package can be used.
A standard with which the artifact complies.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.
Temporary endeavor with a beginning and an end and that must be used to create a unique product, service or result.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasContactPoint
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact has each `to` Agent as a contact point. The use of the `hasContactPoint` type is constrained to `ContactPointRelationship` classed relationships. The type of contact (i.e. security) may be specified using a `ContactPointRelationship` element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nuget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a NuGet package. The package locator format is defined in the [NuGet documentation](https://docs.nuget.org) and looks like `package/version`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform or analyze an application.
An actual change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Book Number (ISBN)](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/isbn-users-manual/29) is a unique numeric identifier for monographic publications standardized by [ISO 2108](https://www.iso.org/standard/65483.html). It consists of either 10 digits (for assignments prior to January 1, 2007) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during development phase of an element.
Timestamp, when an assessment was conducted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/DefinedProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.
Defines the byte range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.
An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: System Package Data Exchange™ (SPDX®) Ontology
rdf:Description.dcterms:abstract: This ontology defines the terms and relationships used in the SPDX specification to describe system packages
rdf:Description.dcterms:creator: SPDX Project
rdf:Description.dcterms:title: System Package Data Exchange (SPDX) Ontology

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Abstract class for the portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a license.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patch
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element contains a set of changes to update, fix, or improve another Element.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who was previously managing goods, services, or assets.
This is the state of an affected Element at a specific moment in time.
Reproduction is the biological process by which living organisms produce offspring.
The record of destruction is entered in this action.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.
A key with an Element.
Provides a CVSS version 2.0 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.
Specifies the licenseId that is preferred to be used in place of a deprecated License or LicenseAddition.
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by each `to` Agent.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
A LicenseAddition participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction points to the `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.
ResponsibilityChangeProcess refers to the process of transferring responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).
A distinct unit representing a constraint associated with an item's use in a system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
Class that describes a physical instance of Hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory is defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.
Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container runtime application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's testing phase, during development.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPenTestReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a [penetration test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penetration_test) report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.
Specifies a human language used within the content of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.
EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: locatedAt
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: `from` Element located at a specific `to` Location. A time period is optional.
The Boundary Definition Process refers to the process class used to produce boundaries.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.
A key with an associated value.
UnitOfMeasure specify information structures through industry standards for Units of Measure, Quantity Kinds, Dimensions and Data Types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasInput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element has each `to` Element as an input.
The result of applying a hash algorithm to an Element.
Specifies an Element where a vulnerability was found.
Type of data in a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.
An SPDX version 2.X compatible verification method for software packages.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
Records if sensitive personal information is used during model training or could be used during the inference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: report
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured documentation of test results, inspections, or analyses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: filesystemImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a file system image that can be written to a disk (or virtual) partition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been approved by stakeholder, and can be include in traceability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.
A value used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.
Identifies the nature of the contactPointRelationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element describes each `to` Element. To denote the root(s) of a tree of elements in a collection, the rootElement property shall be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vatNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Value Added Tax (VAT) number, or Goods and Services Tax (GST) number, is an identifier assigned by tax authorities that uniquely identifies a business within a specific national border or tax jurisdiction for the collection and tracking of VAT/GST.
Specifies the type of the content identifier.
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.
Provides the location for more information regarding an external identifier.
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: firmware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides low level control over a device's hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance of terms.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation architectures with precise cycle-level accuracy.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the issue tracker for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kilowattHour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Kilowatt-hour.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted

Software provided as a service over a network.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: framework
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software framework.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.
